scope: Compact UI and aerodynamic result visualization; numerical solver modules and worker bundles unchanged.

independent_checks.browser: In-app Chromium, actual clicks and input. Standard sequence: NACA 2412, semi-span 450 mm, root/tip 160/100 mm, V=18 m/s, rho=1.225 kg/m3, alpha=5 deg.
independent_checks.surface_cp: Upper/lower base-mesh contour displayed; downloaded CSV verified independently.
independent_checks.load_application: Applied successfully; 81-element spatial-beam stress solved in 1.76 s. Unresolved torque and twist withheld with visible admission explanation.

limitations: Cp, pressure and sectional Cp are from the base mesh; not extrapolated.
Inviscid potential flow: no viscous drag, stall or separated-flow prediction.
This release does not include the separate shell/solid FE package.
